_meta.conventions: Namespace pattern: pages.<route>.<element>, components.<feature>.<element>, common.<element>, errors.<context>. Keys camelCase, values native Russian. Pluralization uses ICU MessageFormat with Russian categories: {count, plural, one {объект} few {объекта} many {объектов} other {объекта}}.
